_comment: Size budget for scripts/bundle-report.mjs --budget (rules: scripts/lib/bundle-budget.mjs; policy and the agent rule: docs/agents/bundle.md). entryGzip = gzip bytes of assets/app-*.js, precacheBytes = PWA precache bytes. Both float: a build may sit within +-2% of them; raising one needs the `bundle-growth` label, a build more than 2% below fails with the value to lower it to. ceiling = the FE-157 targets, a hard limit with no tolerance: 150000 B = 150.00 kB gzip app chunk, 1000000 B = 1000.00 kB precache (1 kB = 1000 B as kb() prints); raising it needs the `bundle-ceiling` label, the owner's. History of raises: git log. skinned = the same two budgets for a build WITH a skin package (FE-230: the core is neutral, production always ships a package -- its photo and font join the precache); bundle-report picks it when dist/skin/report.json exists (a build with a package writes it); `package` and `tag` name what it was measured with, `repo` is where CI fetches it from.
